correctness.rationale: A^18=I+19B with B nonzero modulo 19 and matrix binomial lifting proves the exact prime-power index period. The first 19-adic derivatives are units in exactly 17 of 18 index classes, giving full-ball isometries and baseline multiplicities w. At the sole critical class, the Lucas trace is an isometry, and 5F_n²=4+L_n² together with a 19-adic square-root change of coordinates gives an exact scaled quadratic normal form. Standard square-root counts then prove every residue fiber and its maximum. Direct full-period finite checker confirms all targets for k=1..4; the theorem is infinite due to the symbolic proof, not extrapolated finite data.

value.rationale: Prior work established the support and density of Fibonacci residues at prime 19 but not how often individual reachable values occur. Exact targetwise fibers quantify this intrinsic image-measure nonuniformity at every precision, distinguish regular branches from a singular quadratic branch, and reveal unbounded maximum representation counts. These are natural structural arithmetic invariants that cannot be recovered from the published image sizes alone.
